en.sayed-ali-raza: They are a people whom honour has always followed till they were made to settle in the house of eternal abode, and they obtained rest from the movement of journeying.

O listerner! If you busy yourself in advancing towards these wonderful scenes which will rush towards you, then your heart will certainly die due to eagerness for them, and you will be prepared to seek the company of those in the graves straight away from my audience here and hasten towards them.
